title: Social Media Data Annotation
features: Coded and categorized 200+ Reddit posts to develop a topic taxonomy.
Annotated 600+ movie-related posts with consistent labels.
Processed and organized datasets using Python for analysis.
Supported analysis of movie visibility and reception.
complete-features: Performed open coding on 200+ Reddit posts to design a topic taxonomy, enforcing single-label classification per post.
Manually annotated 600+ posts for movie-related topics, ensuring consistent labeling and high data quality.
Processed and organized datasets using Python (CSV parsing, filtering, and train/test-style splits) to support downstream analysis.
Supported analysis of movie visibility and reception through structured, high-quality annotated data.

title: OKaraoke
features: Built OKaraoke, a website that turns YouTube videos link into a karaoke experience with lyric alignment and pitch scoring.
Front-end: Developed animated Cover, Loading screen (Disk), and Scoring UI components with TypeScript, Tailwind, and DaisyUI.
Implemented Python audio-processing with Aubio for MIDI conversion and pitch extraction.
Analyzed microphone input and compared it to MIDI data for real-time pitch scoring.

title: Web Scraping Trending News
features: Built a Python scraper using requests and BeautifulSoup to extract 5 trending news articles from the Montreal Gazette.
Implemented HTML caching system (1-hour expiry) with custom User-Agent headers to prevent blocking.
Parsed and cleaned article titles, authors, publication dates, and blurbs into a structured JSON output.
